gap: No result ChatGPT got states what each batteryless option costs today: SMA's Sunny Boy 7.0 with its built-in 2,000 W sunlight-only outlet is $1,625.48 at Northern Arizona Wind & Sun. Enphase's route needs the IQ System Controller 3 alone at $2,199.00 at Signature Solar, before any $186.66 IQ8MC microinverters. The Sun Gold SPH6548P all-in-one, which its maker says 'supports battery-free', is $1,035.00 on sungoldpower.com.
standout_why: I compared against outagemath.com (top uncited result) and ChatGPT's cited Enphase and Sol-Ark pages. Outagemath already lists the 2,000 W SMA outlet, the Enphase 30%-of-array limit, the EG4 'PV Grid Off' mode and that Sol-Ark needs a battery for backup. It also gives a rough Enphase parts estimate ($3,000 to $3,500) and says the SMA outlet is 'included with the inverter'. It gives no dated store prices, though, and it never names the Sun Gold SPH6548P. I could not open Enphase's cited iq8-grid brief: WebFetch only returned compressed PDF data. ChatGPT's own cards priced only the EG4 ($3,999.99) and the Sol-Ark ($5,299). So my dated prices are new, but the feature comparison is mostly already on the outagemath page.
decides: On price, the SMA Sunny Boy with Secure Power Supply is the cheapest proven way to get daytime power in an outage without a battery: about $1,625 for the inverter, with the outlet built in. Enphase IQ8 Sunlight Backup powers several circuits automatically, but the controller alone is $2,199 on top of the microinverters. The EG4 18kPV ($3,999.99) and the Sol-Ark 15K cost more, and their store pages don't promise batteryless backup. Our Sun Gold SPH6548P ($1,035) is the cheapest. But it's an off-grid unit (its listing says 'UL 1741 by ETL for Off Grid Solar System'), and all I could source is the one line 'supports battery-free'. Until a Sun Gold manual confirms it powers loads from solar alone with no grid, it shouldn't be the pick for an outage. That confirms the shortlist, SMA SPS for one outlet or Enphase IQ8 for whole circuits, and puts dated prices on it.
